text:
dmitri: Heads up — new model candidate PEARL-7B landed from partner. Need a quick smoke bring-up + quant experiment plan. Goal: validate perf/regression against Lumen-13B baseline and prepare a catalog entry + short announcement.
sara: Thanks. Can you paste the model card and HF link? I’ll start a smoke run on staging GPUs. :eyes:
dmitri: HF: https://huggingface.co/partner/pearl-7b
Model card: small-steps, mostly instruction-tuned, no RLHF notes. Weight files in s3://redwood-models/pearl-7b/ (v0.1).
kevin: Staging pool has available A10s tonight after 19:00 UTC. Do we want q4/q8s static quant or PTQ sweep? PTQ needs calibration data.
sara: Let’s do PTQ sweep (q4f16, q8_fine) + a baseline FP16 run. Short list of evals: MMLU subset, HellaSwag, our in-house safety prompts, and 3 customer prompts from the catalog (anita will provide).
anita: I shared three anonymized customer prompts in the shared drive (docs/announcements/samples). Also flag: product wants release note blurb and per-route latency target <= 150ms p50 for short-gen (<=128 tokens).
dmitri: Checklist proposal (quick):
```
- fetch model artifacts + checksum
- run fp16 smoke (basic generate + 1k token perf)
- run PTQ calibrations (3 datasets)
- run quantitative evals (MMLU-sub, HellaSwag)
- run regression tests vs lumen-13b: accuracy + hallucination heuristics
- perf: p50/p99 latency, tokens/sec, memory
- catalog entry draft (tags, cost_estimates, quant-variants)
- docs PR (example usage, caveats)
- announce draft for #announcements + support playbook
```
sara: I can take the smoke + perf runs. ETA: results in ~6h after start. Will attach the raw bench logs.
kevin: I’ll provision a short-run cluster for PTQ tonight. Running run_bench.sh --model pearl-7b --quant ptq --calib ./calib_sets/fast
Expect ~2–3 hours for full sweep.
eva: deploy-bot: scheduled job created: pearl-7b-smoke-1909876543 — status: queued
anita: For the catalog entry, minimal fields we need now: model_name, origin, license, recommended_variant (quant/fp), cost_multiplier_vs_lumen-13b, safety_notes, supported_api_routes. I’ll start a stub in Notion.
dmitri: Two risk flags: 1) partner license includes noncommercial clause? I asked legal — awaiting. 2) tokenizer differences -> some customers saw tokenization length shifts vs lumen; include explicit tokenization note.
sara: Quick log excerpt from fp16 smoke:
```
> gen --prompt "Explain recursion"
latency p50: 82ms, p95: 210ms, mem: 17.2GB
sample perplexity vs lumen: +0.2
```
kevin: PTQ early result q4: p50 improves 22%, memory drops 40%, but we saw small drop on HellaSwag (~1.5% absolute). Need to evaluate quality delta on safety prompts.
anita: Product ok with a small HellaSwag hit if safety and hallucination regressions are zero. Please quantify in the evaluation doc.
dmitri: Plan for next steps: sara + kevin finish runs; I’ll assemble catalog draft + PR template for docs. If legal clears license, we schedule a soft announcement next Tue in #announcements with a short catalog link and upgrade notes. Can everyone ack?
sara: ack — will upload logs + perf table to the thread when done.
kevin: ack — PTQ sweep running, will post outputs.
eva: deploy-bot: job pearl-7b-smoke-1909876543 completed: success (logs: s3://redwood-bench/1909876543)
dmitri: thanks. When results are in I’ll open a PR: docs + catalog entry + announce draft. If any showstoppers (safety regressions >0 or license issue) we hold. :thumbsup:
anita: I’ll draft the announcement blurb and support playbook after you open the PR. Include recommended default variant: q4f16 (if quality within 0.5% of baseline) or fp16 otherwise.
sara: uploading perf csv now -> s3://redwood-bench/1909876543/perf.csv
dmitri: perfect. Closing loop here — will post PR link in the thread shortly.
